title: ATEM switchers
description: The switchers to connect, how each moves with GodwinMix, and which input shows which GodwinMix source. Switchers can also be added while the plugin runs, with connect.

switchers.title: Switchers
switchers.description: One entry per switcher. A switcher with a mistake in it is left out and named in the plugin's log; the others still connect.

id.description: A slug naming the switcher, such as atem-main or atem-overflow.

address.description: The switcher's IP address or host name, with :port only when it is not 9910.

name.description: A name for people. The id when left out.

mode.description: own: driven only from the camera window and agents. follow: a take in GodwinMix also cuts the switcher to the mapped input. lead: a cut on the switcher moves GodwinMix to the mapped source.

map.title: Source map
map.description: GodwinMix source id to ATEM input number, such as {"cam-pulpit": 1}.
